title: Lockheed divests a craft, which may end up at Picatinny Arsenal
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Lockheed divests a craft, which may end up at Picatinny Arsenal, about unspecified at Picatinny Arsenal, New Jersey, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

as_told.title: Lockheed UFO material held by Peraton at Picatinny

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says his friend Rob Jones, a researcher, has found that Lockheed, the big American aerospace company, eventually handed off a craft it held, he thinks to an investment firm called Veritas Capital. Jones himself says the material is now held by a defense company he names as Peraton (heard on air as 'Paritin' or 'Peritin'), which has offices at Picatinny Arsenal, a US Army research base in New Jersey, and in one telling he dates this from 2008 to the present. If true, it would mean a mysterious craft has quietly passed between private companies.
